Tests that read-only geometry methods are side-effect-free.
Expression `div.getClientRects().item(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMRect.fromRect({width: 10}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMRectReadOnly.fromRect({width: 10}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMPoint.fromPoint({x: 1}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMPointReadOnly.fromPoint({x: 1}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(DOMPointReadOnly.fromPoint({x: 1, y: 2}))`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `point.matrixTransform({a: 2, e: 10})`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrix.fromMatrix({a: 2, e: 10}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrixReadOnly.fromMatrix({a: 2, e: 10}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(DOMMatrixReadOnly.fromMatrix({a: 2, e: 10}))`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrix.fromFloat32Array(f32)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrix.fromFloat64Array(f64)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrixReadOnly.fromFloat32Array(f32)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMMatrixReadOnly.fromFloat64Array(f64)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.translate(1, 2)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.scale(2)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.scaleNonUniform(2, 3)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.scale3d(2)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.rotate(45)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.rotateFromVector(1, 1)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.rotateAxisAngle(0, 0, 1, 45)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.skewX(10)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.skewY(10)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.multiply({a: 2, e: 5})`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.flipX()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.flipY()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.inverse()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.transformPoint({x: 1, y: 2})`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.toFloat32Array()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.toFloat64Array()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMQuad.fromRect({width: 5}).getBounds()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `DOMQuad.fromQuad({p1: {x: 1, y: 2}}).toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(DOMQuad.fromQuad({p1: {x: 1, y: 2}}))`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `quad.getBounds()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `quad.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(quad)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `matrix.translateSelf(1, 2)`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `matrix.setMatrixValue('translate(1px, 2px)')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `DOMRect.fromRect({ get width() { window.pwned = 1; return 10; } })`
has side effect: true, expected: true
